_comment: IRONSPELLSPLAN — the rare end of the 'stronger = rarer' dial. The Upgrade Orb is Iron's Spells' scarce gear-upgrade item, so it drops only in the deadliest / most-gated explore structures, and rarely. A lucky low roll can still turn one up — that's intended. Inert without Iron's Spells (Lookup.hasItem gate in AddDropModifier).
